# Third-party code

- `peerjs.min.js` — [PeerJS](https://peerjs.com) 1.5.5, MIT License (Copyright (c) 2015 Michelle Bu and Eric Zhang, http://peerjs.com).
  Used for online play: it connects the two players directly (WebRTC) after they find each other through
  PeerJS's public matchmaking server. `build.py` includes it in the full builds only.
